mapper.sql: SELECT c.ROOM_ID, c.MEMBER_ID, m.MEMBER_NAME, c.STATUS, c.STARTED_AT, c.WAITING_AT, (SELECT MAX(NVL(x.CONTENT, x.ATTACHMENT_NAME)) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY x.SENT_AT, x.MESSAGE_ID) FROM TBL_CHAT_MESSAGE x WHERE x.ROOM_ID = c.ROOM_ID AND x.SENDER_TYPE = '01') AS LAST_MESSAGE, (SELECT MAX(x.SENT_AT) FROM TBL_CHAT_MESSAGE x WHERE x.ROOM_ID = c.ROOM_ID) AS LAST_AT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TBL_CHAT_MESSAGE x WHERE x.ROOM_ID = c.ROOM_ID AND x.SENDER_TYPE = '01' AND x.IS_READ = 'N') AS UNREAD FROM TBL_CHAT_ROOM c JOIN TBL_MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = c.MEMBER_ID
mapper.select: WHERE c.STATUS != '04' ORDER BY LAST_AT DESC NULLS LAST, c.ROOM_ID DESC

SELECT * FROM (
WHERE c.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND c.STATUS != '04' ORDER BY c.STARTED_AT DESC, c.ROOM_ID DESC) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_CHAT_ROOM.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TBL_CHAT_ROOM (ROOM_ID, MEMBER_ID, STATUS, STARTED_AT) VALUES (#{room.roomId}, #{memberId}, '01', SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE TBL_CHAT_ROOM SET STATUS = #{status}, WAITING_AT = CASE WHEN #{status} = '02' THEN SYSDATE ELSE WAITING_AT END, ADMIN_ID = CASE WHEN #{status} = '03' THEN NVL(#{adminId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, ADMIN_ID) ELSE ADMIN_ID END, ENDED_AT = CASE WHEN #{status} = '04' THEN SYSDATE ELSE NULL END WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM TBL_CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND MESSAGE_ID > #{after} ORDER BY SENT_AT, MESSAGE_ID
